answer: A copper bond gates every new identity: each agent locks refundable copper in escrow, slashed if it attests falsely. The cost climbs like a dune — every extra identity funded from the same wallet pays a higher bond, so a sybil farm's bill grows faster than its fake count. Newcomers start weightless and only earn full weight at the zenith of the trust ladder after months of attested useful work, so cheap clones stay powerless while honest agents compound reputation.
